esac; _etty_emit \"\$(printf \"]133;C\\007\")\"; }" "PROMPT_COMMAND=_etty_cwd" "trap _etty_pre DEBUG" > "$c/rc.$$" && mv -f "$c/rc.$$" "$c/rc"; printf "%s\n" "d=\$(cd -- \"\$(dirname -- \"\$0\")\" && pwd)" "exec \"\${SHELL:-/bin/sh}\" --rcfile \"\$d/rc\" -i" > "$c/init.$$" && mv -f "$c/init.$$" "$c/init"; else printf "%s\n" "exec \"\${SHELL:-/bin/sh}\" -l" > "$c/init.$$" && mv -f "$c/init.$$" "$c/init"; fi; chmod 700 "$c/init" 2>/dev/null; printf "%s\n" "set -g allow-passthrough on" "set -g status off" "set -g mouse off" "set -s set-clipboard on" "set -as terminal-features \",*:clipboard\"" "bind-key -T copy-mode Enter send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel" "bind-key -T copy-mode-vi Enter send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel" "bind-key -T copy-mode-vi y send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel" "set -s extended-keys on" "set -as terminal-features \",*:extkeys\"" "bind-key -n S-Enter send-keys Escape \"[13;2u\"" "bind-key -n C-M-S-Up if -F \"#{alternate_on}\" \"\" \"copy-mode -e ;
